user: I'm CUS-0004. Transaction TX-0401, 240.00 EUR: the goods never arrived. Which reason code applies? State the transaction ID and amount too. Do not open a dispute.
answer:
What I did
- Looked up your account (CUS-0004) and the transaction you specified.

What I found
- Transaction ID: TX-0401
- Amount: 240.00 EUR
- Merchant: TechMart Online
- Date: 2026-07-20
- Status: settled
- Applicable reason code: goods_not_received — this is the correct code when paid goods never arrived.
- The disputes guidance shows a goods_not_received window of 90 days from the transaction date. TX-0401 is 100 days old (2026-07-20 → 2026-10-28), which exceeds that 90-day window, so a dispute under this code would likely be ineligible.

What happens next
- I will not open a dispute, per your instruction. If you want me to confirm formal eligibility (a non‑opening check) I can run check_dispute_eligibility for TX-0401 and report back. Let me know if you want that or want to escalate to a human agent.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Reason code guide
## Choosing a code
The reason code must match what actually happened. A dispute filed under the
wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past its window.

Reason code guide
## service_not_rendered
Used when a paid-for service was not provided. Evidence: the booking or
contract and the date the service was due.

Reason code guide
## duplicate_charge
Used when the same purchase was debited more than once. Evidence: references of
both transactions. This code carries the shortest window of the purchase codes.
